rationale: Manjot brings 15+ years of hands-on software development and a track record scaling a 200+ client mobile development shop across iOS, Android, and cross-platform tech—domains Alex works in at Mercor. Alex's expertise in ML infrastructure and developer tooling directly addresses Manjot's explicit hiring needs for technical talent and could inform how Ajath approaches AI-augmented hiring or internal tooling; conversely, Manjot's experience shipping production systems at scale across fintech and healthcare could ground Alex's thinking on real-world constraints in ML dev tooling adoption.
intro_message: Manjot Singh, meet Alex Kreidler — Alex builds ML infrastructure and developer tools at Mercor, and your background scaling mobile development across fintech and healthcare could offer practical perspective on the real-world friction points Alex is solving for.
